summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X S&P 500 Covered Call & Growth ETF (XYLG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Cboe S&P 500 Half BuyWrite index. The fund tracks an index of S&P 500 stocks and sells one-month, at-the-money call options on up to 50% of each stock. XYLG was launched on Sep 18, 2020 and is issued by Global X.

holdings.infoBox: XYLG is an equity ETF with a total of 506 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.37%, Apple at 7.33%, Microsoft at 5.75%, Alphabet at 5.47%, and Amazon.com at 3.69%.
